description: A set of independent on/off buttons in a shared track — any number can be pressed, including none. Framed like a Button: a pressed item is action/primary, an unpressed one action/secondary, inside a transparent bordered track whose radius is concentric with the items.

props.name: type
props.description:
Selects single-selection semantics: at most one item pressed at a time,
and pressing the active item again clears the selection.
Selects multiple-selection semantics: any number of items can be pressed
simultaneously and each toggles independently.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render a single consumer-supplied element in place of the native
`<div>`, with the group's `role="group"`, `data-orientation`, and `ref`
merged onto it via the {@link Slot } pattern.

props.name: children
props.description:
The {@link ToggleGroupItemProps`ToggleGroup.Item`} elements that make
up the segmented control.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Value of the item pressed on first render. Omit to start with nothing
pressed.
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `value`.
Values of the items pressed on first render. Omit to start with nothing

props.name: dir
props.description:
Reading direction. In `"rtl"` the horizontal arrow keys are mirrored so
focus follows the visual order. Inherited from the nearest
{@link DirectionProvider } when omitted, falling back to `"ltr"`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode.
Called with the requested next value — the pressed item's value, or
`undefined` when the active item is pressed again to deselect it.
Called with the complete next array of pressed values whenever the user

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Layout axis for keyboard navigation. `"horizontal"` binds
ArrowLeft/ArrowRight; `"vertical"` binds ArrowUp/ArrowDown. Surfaces as
`data-orientation` on the root for styling; it does not itself apply any
flex/grid layout.

props.name: value
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — use `defaultValue`.
The currently pressed item's value, or `undefined` when none is pressed.
Must be kept in sync by the caller via `onValueChange`.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Control size for the whole widget; `data-density` scales each size further.

contractProps.name: justify
contractProps.description: Whether items size to their content or share the track width equally.

Identifies this item within the group. It is this string — not the
visible label — that is compared against the group's pressed
`value` / `defaultValue`; use `children` for the label.

props.name: asChild

Render a single consumer-supplied element in place of the native
`<button>`, with the item's `aria-pressed`, `data-state`, `tabIndex`, and

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Forwards the native `disabled` attribute and removes the item from the

`data-disabled=""` for CSS targeting.

api.description:
`<primitiv-toggle-group>` — the state owner of a group of toggle buttons.

The root is the group: it takes `role="group"`, so name it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. Only one item is in the page's Tab order at a time — the item focus last moved to, else the first pressed item, else the first — and the arrow keys move between items. The root reconciles its items' ARIA whenever an item arrives, leaves, or changes an attribute the root reads (the lifecycle is `PrimitivRootElement`'s). `type` is read live at each toggle, so a change to it needs no reconcile.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The pressed items' values, separated by spaces. Reflected: it changes as the user presses items, so a server re-render or a history snapshot sees what is pressed. Item values therefore cannot contain whitespace.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: `single` keeps at most one item pressed — pressing another lets go of it, and pressing it again leaves none; `multiple` lets items toggle independently. Defaults to `single`.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout axis, which picks the arrow-key pair. Defaults to `horizontal`.

events.name: primitiv-toggle-group-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user-driven toggle is applied, with every item pressed afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

api.description: `<primitiv-toggle-group-item>` — an interactive part: one toggle. It decorates exactly one child the consumer writes, a `<button>`, which gets `aria-pressed`, `data-state="on" | "off"` and the roving `tabindex`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The item's value, listed in the root's `value` while it is pressed. No whitespace.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Skipped by the arrow keys and never pressed (`aria-disabled` and `data-disabled` on the child).
